question: According to the latest NSSO consumer expenditure survey conducted in 2024, what is the reported poverty rate in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Below 5%**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the** National Sample Survey Organisation (NSSO) consumer expenditure survey conducted in 2024, India's poverty rate is below 5%**
 
• The **per capita monthly expenditure** has increased to **INR 3,773 in rural areas** and **INR 6,459 in urban areas**, reflecting improved living standards.
 
• With sustained efforts in poverty alleviation, **people in both rural and urban areas are becoming more prosperous**, showcasing the success of developmental initiatives.
 
• The decline in poverty highlights India's strides toward achieving greater economic equity and enhancing the quality of life for its citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **NSSO is an organization under the Ministry of Statistics of the Government** of India that conducts a survey every five years to estimate poverty in India.
 
• The NSSO** was established in 1950.**
 
• The survey uses a stratified multistage random sampling technique to select households from different strata, such as rural and urban.
 
• 
 
• The** data collected is then processed and analyzed to ensure reliability and precision.**
 
• The** final data is published in reports that are used for policy formulation and academic research**
